description: Public booking pages; subscriber calendars and client records; appointment changes; deposits through the hosted checkout links
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 240 subscribers run their day from the calendar; the 14-hour outage on 2026-03-11 led to 3 cancellations (about $2,300 a year of revenue). RPO set by the database point-in-time recovery; RTO 4 hours is supported only if a restore takes about 2 hours as tested on 2026-08-27
manual_workaround: Each location receives a 6 a.m. email digest of the day's appointments; subscribers take bookings by phone and enter them after recovery; status page notice
dependent_third_parties: Hosting provider; domain registrar and DNS
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-developer (single point of failure: only person who can deploy or restore); home office

description: Confirmation and reminder messages by SMS and email; Smart Replies drafts in the subscriber inbox
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Next-day reminders go out at 10 a.m.; missing them raises no-shows for subscribers. Reminder queue state is in the database. Smart Replies can be switched off with no business impact
manual_workaround: Subscribers call or text clients from the day digest; Smart Replies feature flag off; messaging provider can be swapped by changing API keys
dependent_third_parties: Email service; SMS provider; AI model provider

description: Help desk tickets and live chat; account setup; data export requests
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Subscribers expect same-day answers during an outage; export requests have a contract commitment but no fixed deadline
manual_workaround: Status page and an email to all subscriber admins; owner answers from the business email account
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-developer; freelance support contractor (about 10 hours a week)

description: Code changes, security patches, and deployments through the CI/CD pipeline
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Needed to ship a fix during an incident; the code is in the repository and on the laptop, so code loss is unlikely; RPO 24 hours covers unpushed work
manual_workaround: Deploy from the laptop with the hosting command-line tool (break-glass only); pause non-urgent changes

description: Monthly subscription charges, failed-payment retries, invoices, and payouts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $15,000 billed a month; the processor retries failed charges for several days; personal savings cover about two months of expenses
manual_workaround: Processor keeps billing on its own schedule; manual invoices from the accounting SaaS
